findings.statement: Outcome-independent reduction modulo complete degree two leaves cubic quotient dimensions 75, 371, and 16 on 6x3-k3, 4x5-k4, and 6x3-k4.

Relative to degree two, the residual scalar target dimension is one on 6x3-k3 and two on 4x5-k4 and 6x3-k4; the earlier two-dimensional result was specifically relative to the affine repaired-coordinate span.
In the deterministic basis gauge frozen only after outcome-independent cubic reduction, every nonzero cubic scalar target coefficient is an OOO interaction among three distinct descriptor identities.

4x5-k4 contains 77 independent OOP cubic structural directions, yet none is used by either scalar target bit in the deterministic EW-RS-060 gauge, separating cubic structural complexity from scalar target support.

nonclaims: OOO-only cubic sufficiency is not established by this integration; EW-RS-061 is the explicit falsifier.
Deterministic target coefficient supports are basis-gauge dependent.
No final syndrome formula has been selected.
No Q-A/Q-F or standard-7x6 claim follows.
